propositions: compact.py exceeds the 800 LOC size cap at 798 lines and bundles three distinct responsibilities: compaction transaction, snapshot reconstruction, and CLI surface

Extraction of transaction engine to compact_txn.py and snapshot reconstruction engine to compact_rebuild.py with shared primitives in compact_txn resolves circular dependency and reduces complexity of _compact_locked (CCN 24) and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log (CCN 21)
Counter _REBUILD_COUNT and function get_rebuild_count must be co-located in compact_rebuild.py to ensure module global consistency when rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log increments the counter
CLI facade in compact.py requires internal re-imports of _compact_locked, _sync_before_compact, and _git from compact_txn.py for its own retained functions
Public re-exports from compact.py must preserve import paths for external consumers and test code that patch module internals at test seams in test_compact_negative.py
